justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Systematic reviews inconclusive; studies methodologically limited. Widespread use in ASD and developmental delay not matched by outcome evidence.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: WPS test publisher certification plus supervised training; significant time and cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to pediatric OT with sensory processing disorder focus; common in pediatric outpatient and school-based OT.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Sensory integration therapy billed under OT codes; variable commercial coverage; Medicaid coverage inconsistent.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Widely sought in pediatric OT positions; strong adoption in school-based and outpatient pediatric OT settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Families of sensory-sensitive children report perceived improvement.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Pediatric SI clinics are a well-established cash-pay model; parents pay out-of-pocket when insurance denies.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Specialized peds SI clinics command premium rates and waitlists.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: SIPT/CLASI credentialing is recognizable within the peds parent community; meaningful differentiation.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Scalable — multi-therapist SI clinics are a proven model; you can hire and credential staff.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong parent-driven demand, especially in autism and SPD communities.
justifications.business.efficiency: Expensive multi-module training (USC/CLASI) and equipment-heavy clinic build-out reduce efficiency.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Respected in OT academia, particularly peds tracks, though not a board-level credential.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active research community (Ayres Sensory Integration fidelity studies), but uneven publication output.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Core for peds OT faculty teaching SI and developmental coursework.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence remains contested; mixed systematic reviews limit academic weight.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Listed in peds-focused OT faculty postings but not universal.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: High cost and time investment for moderate academic recognition.
